title: onboard-orion-sky-14b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Onboard Orion-Sky 14B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles, model card, and automate changelog entries.

Motivation: Orion-Sky is a high-throughput 14B variant we've validated for streaming chat and completions workloads. Adding it to the registry provides verified perf profiles so serving and routing logic can make cost/latency decisions. This PR also adds a small automation script to append release notes to the registry CHANGELOG when a model is promoted.

What this PR includes:
- models/orion-sky-14b/v1.0/metadata.json: canonical metadata (architecture, params, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, default KV/cache hints)
- models/orion-sky-14b/v1.0/perf/profiles.yaml: perf profiles (p50/p95 latency, throughput across batch sizes, memory footprint, recommended device types and kernel flags)
- models/orion-sky-14b/v1.0/model-card.md: short model card with evaluation summary and intended uses/limitations
- scripts/changelog/append_model_release.py: simple CLI used by model onboarding pipeline to append standardized release notes to docs/changes/CHANGELOG.md
- tests/registry/test_onboard_orion_sky.py: small unit/integration checks for metadata schema and perf profile parsing
- docs/changes/CHANGELOG.md: appended release entry via automation in CI step when promoted
- ci/workflows/onboard-model.yml: added a promotion workflow step to run changelog append in dry-run on PRs and append on merge to main

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata schema validated against registry JSON schema
- [x] Perf profiles generated by perf-harness and sanity-checked against baseline models
- [x] Model card reviewed by research (María)
- [x] Changelog automation added and unit tested

Notes on backward compatibility: metadata fields follow existing schema; new optional fields (quantization_recommendations, kv_cache_recommendation) are additive and do not break consumers.

Linear/Jira: ENG-3421 covers the perf verification work; PM-778 requested model entry for Q2 launch.
